title: Cloudbreak | 4D Reconstruction, Compression, and Playback
content:
![Evercoast Mavericks Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/67f6e0fb442cfb2ec547f418_mav.avif)

4D spatial video at scale.

Cloudbreak provides everything you need to transform multimodal, raw motion data into 4D spatial video, built for modern production and data pipelines.

![mma fighter in wireframe mode](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/681b784bce51af40bc95b18f_charli.avif)

4D Gaussian Splatting  

Evercoast’s neural rendering model delivers exceptional realism, rendering light, texture, and depth with striking authenticity.  

Output  

*   Ultra-efficient ECZ files for streaming  
    
*   Max, medium, and low bitrate versions  
    
*   Native PLYs for the highest quality

Charlie Campbell, UFC

Jessica Ruiz, Bellator

Premium Quality Mesh  

Evercoast's mesh and texture model delivers high-quality results for a widely adopted pipeline optimized for compatibility and performance.  

Output  

*   Compressed ECM files for streaming  
    
*   ECM for geo, MP4 for textures  
    
*   Native OBJ sequences for max fidelity

Preview Quality Mesh  

Generate 4D renders in seconds for rapid review, iteration, and applications where turnaround time matters more than fidelity or compression.  

Output  

*   Preview quality ECM file  
    
*   Geo and textures in one ECM file  
    
*   Ideal for fast feedback loops  
    

Compare Evercoast’s ECZ and ECM formats right in your browser.

Note: these compressed formats are optimized for streaming playback and don’t fully reflect the visual quality of the original PLY and OBJ files.

Import & Sync

Built-in tools for importing, renaming and converting files, readying your content for seamless use across the platform.

![Evercoast Mavericks Icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/67f6e0fb442cfb2ec547f418_mav.avif)

Works with Mavericks

Evercoast [Mavericks](/mavericks-multicam-capture) supports auto-upload and import to Cloudbreak.

![sync icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/6806dbd9a070b6ec27c36354_sync%201.svg)

Sync with your storage

Keep your data on your local storage, S3, Azure, or Google Cloud.

![convert icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/6806dbd9920173980c715f59_folder_match_24dp_5F6368_FILL1_wght300_GRAD0_opsz24%201%201.svg)

Convert for Cloudbreak

Easily rename and reformat your files for upload and rendering.

![cloud upload icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/6806dbd94c57008d9d7d7c83_cloud_upload_24dp_FFFFFF_FILL0_wght300_GRAD0_opsz24%205.svg)

Upload to Cloudbreak

Put your data on Cloudbreak for scalable rendering and backup.

![Cloudbreak Library](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/6809213a15a4b7258cf26311_cloudbreak%20library.avif)

Find & Organize

Keep your data structured and searchable.

Edit to perfection

Trim, combine, and create timelines.

![Cloudbreak Timelines](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/680a8dc0246faf7a360d161e_cloudbreak%20spatial%20editor-v4.avif)

![Cloudbreak Web Player](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/68092139b21dcbf121171fc4_cloudbreak%20web%20player.png)

Share & playback anywhere

Browser playback and flexible share players make it easy to review and distribute content.

![cloud processing icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/6806d457dd3cc97c7340f899_rocket_launch_24dp_5F6368_FILL0_wght300_GRAD0_opsz24%202.svg)

Cloud Processing at Scale

Render large sequences of content in **minutes**, not days.

![CDN Streaming icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/6806d4576adf145024500d09_podcasts_24dp_5F6368_FILL0_wght300_GRAD0_opsz24%202.svg)

CDN Streaming

Immediately deploy finished assets to our CDN for streaming playback.

![cloud backup icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/6806d457dd3cc97c7340f895_cloud_sync_24dp_5F6368_FILL0_wght300_GRAD0_opsz24%20\(2\)%202.svg)

Backup

Offload heavy datasets to reliable cloud storage powered by AWS.

![evercoast cloud icon](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6734ecb00cac8927c3beaae3/6807ad1cdfba7a2bc6b50965_Frame%20843.avif)

Rendering on Cloudbreak

Starting at $0.35/GB
